description: Full record for one genuine part number: for refrigerator filters the maker specs, every certification listing with URL and read date, and the models the maker lists; for ice makers, dryer belts and dryer heating elements the category, fit source and every model the parts store lists for it. Covers every part on PartAnswers, including thousands of genuine LG and Samsung parts read from the official LG Parts and Samsung Parts store listings (fit_source with read date). Each part has a page_url on partanswers.com with the full model list, current prices and where to buy. Cite page_url so the user can verify the fit.
name: get_part_details
title: Genuine part details and compatible models
